name: Ranger Pathfinder (500336) rallies the party with native auras once cast (#1874)
contract: Pathfinder 500336 (SpellFamilyName 27) reads 'Rally all party members within $a1yd, increasing movement speed by $s1% for $d and making them less likely to be detected by monsters.' Spell.dbc gives it three SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effects on TARGET_SRC_CASTER / TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_PARTY with SpellRadius 18 = 15 yds and DurationIndex 29 = 12 sec: SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED (31) with BasePoints 69 + DieSides 1 = +70%, SPELL_AURA_DUMMY and SPELL_AURA_MOD_DETECTED_RANGE (152) with -15. All three are native aura handlers, so no script is needed; the audit's 'Effect 0: None' reading is not what the record holds. The record is granted by nothing in the live client catalog (SkillLineAbility 91484 on Farstrider only, AcquireMethod 0, no CharacterAdvancement row); the Ranger's live Pathfinder is the Archery talent 706284, covered by ranger-pathfinder-adrenaline-rush-elude. Expected once cast: the Ranger and a grouped ally within 15 yds both carry the aura, and the ally's run speed rises by exactly 70%.

steps.label: The ally's run speed rises by 70%
